$sources: HK Code of Practice on Wind Effects in Hong Kong 2019: one reference design wind pressure profile for the whole territory (wind.speedFactors.referencePressures); no seismic loading in the HK codes of this pack
source: HK CoP Wind Effects 2019: the reference pressures by height apply across Hong Kong (no wind speed map), with the topography factor Sq of the site (Project Settings > Wind, Kzt / k3). The V shown is the 3-second gust speed equivalent of the 10 m pressure, √(q(10 m)/0.613), for the display only: the pressures do not use it. Seismic zone 0: earthquake loading is not covered (zoneCoefficients). Elsewhere a custom location.
